invariants.rationale: Typical Java style is to check for null before method calls; most methods of commitTimeline are used without null-checks within the method.
Static analysis: hoodieWriteConfig is dereferenced immediately without null check, so it must be non-null at method entry.
A storage/file size limit should reasonably be positive.
A record size estimation threshold should be a positive fraction or value.
Record size estimates are normally non-negative.
